title: Scalar extension of derived-fibre cohomology under arbitrary pullback
statement: Let $g:Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $E\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category], $i\in\mathbb Z$, and $y\in Y$. Put $x=g(y)$, $k=\kappa(x)$ and $l=\kappa(y)$, with the canonical field homomorphism $k\to l$ induced by $g$. There exists an isomorphism of $l$-vector spaces $H^i(Li_y^*Lg^*E)\simeq l\otimes_k H^i(Li_x^*E)$, where derived pullback is [def-pc-derived-pullback] and fibre cohomology means the globally evaluated and scalar-transported vector space of [def-sc-derived-fiber-betti]. No boundedness or pseudo-coherence hypothesis is required.

proof.text: Choose a complex representing E using essential surjectivity of DerivedCategory.Q, then resolve it by exists_isKFlatResolution. Inverting Q of the augmentation gives eP : Q(P) ≅ E. Obtain additivity of the concrete tensor pullback G from its adjunction. Pullback preserves K-flatness; the termwise G(P) is definitionally the tensorPullbackComplex in isKFlat_pullback.

Unpack the witness defining derivedPullback g. Functor.ext identifies its additive module functor F with G using the recorded object and morphism formulas. The K-flat counit and quotientCompQhIso identify Lg* Q(P) with Q(G(P)); compose its inverse with Lg*(eP) to represent Lg* E. Apply nonempty_kFlat_stalk_residueCohomology_linearEquiv to P at g(y) and G(P) at y.

Use exists_tensorPullback_stalk_iso at y. Write rx and ry for the stalk residue maps, t for g.stalkMap y, and l for g.residueFieldMap y. Mathlib residue_residueFieldMap gives ry.comp t = l.comp rx. Whisker the stalk comparison with extension along ry, and use extendScalarsComp twice with this equality to construct the natural isomorphism (G followed by stalk at y) followed by extension along ry ≅ (stalk at g(y) followed by extension along rx) followed by extension along l. Apply NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex to P and then the degree-i homology functor.

The source of l is a field, so RingHom.Flat.of_isField proves l flat. ModuleCat.preservesFiniteLimits_extendScalars_of_flat together with the scalar-extension left adjunction makes extension along l preserve homology. Apply (K.sc i).mapHomologyIso to the residue stalk complex K. Compose the y-fibre linear equivalence, the complex comparison on homology, this exact-functor comparison, and extension of the inverse x-fibre linear equivalence. This yields exactly the required ModuleCat isomorphism. No boundedness or dimension hypothesis is used.

mathlib_searches.results: Shape-embedding homology results, no derived fibre comparison. Repository KFlatStalkResidueCohomology computes one fibre of a given K-flat representative; Mathlib ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso handles the exact scalar-extension step but not the geometric square.
Module.finrank_baseChange and general homology functor results; no full derived fibre isomorphism. Mathlib ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso is the exact-functor comparison.

theorem derivedFiberCohomology_baseChange_iso (X Y : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ x : X, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u}
      (moduleRings (Spec (X.residueField x)).toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ y : Y, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u}
      (moduleRings (Spec (Y.residueField y)).toRingedSpace))]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory X) (g : Y ⟶ X) (i : ℤ) (y : Y) :
    Nonempty (derivedFiberCohomology Y ((derivedPullback g).obj E) i y ≅
      (ModuleCat.extendScalars (g.residueFieldMap y).hom).obj
        (derivedFiberCohomology X E i (g y)))
